name: Zed
tagline: High-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom.
description:
Zed is a code editor written from scratch in Rust, with its own GPU-accelerated UI framework (GPUI) and a collaboration server also written in Rust.

It was started by the team behind Atom and Tree-sitter, and is open source under GPL/AGPL.

name: Tauri
tagline: Build smaller, faster, and more secure desktop and mobile apps with a web frontend.
description:
Tauri lets you build desktop and mobile applications with any web frontend and a Rust backend. Apps ship with the OS webview instead of bundling a browser, so binaries are a few megabytes.

The core, CLI and plugin system are all Rust.

name: Deno
tagline: A modern runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript, built on V8 and Rust.
description: Deno is a secure runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript. The runtime, module loader, permission system and tooling (formatter, linter, test runner, bundler) are written in Rust on top of V8 and Tokio.

name: Warp
tagline: The intelligent terminal with AI and your dev team's knowledge built in.
description: Warp is a GPU-accelerated terminal written in Rust, with its own UI framework and text rendering. It runs on macOS, Linux and Windows.

name: Astral uv
tagline: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
description: uv replaces pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, virtualenv and more with a single Rust binary that is 10 to 100 times faster. It is built by Astral, the team behind Ruff.

name: Ruff
tagline: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter.
description: Ruff is a Python linter and formatter written in Rust that replaces Flake8, isort, Black and dozens of plugins, running 10 to 100 times faster than the tools it replaces.

name: Meilisearch
tagline: A lightning-fast search engine API bringing AI-powered hybrid search to your sites and applications.
description: Meilisearch is an open source search engine written in Rust. It offers typo tolerance, filtering, faceting and vector search through a simple REST API, and powers a hosted cloud product.

name: SurrealDB
tagline: A scalable, distributed, collaborative, document-graph database for the realtime web.
description: SurrealDB is a multi-model database written in Rust that combines document, graph, relational and time-series workloads behind one query language. It runs embedded, as a single server, or distributed on TiKV or FoundationDB.

name: Polars
tagline: Blazingly fast DataFrames in Rust, Python, Node.js, R and SQL.
description: Polars is a DataFrame library written in Rust on top of Apache Arrow, with a lazy query engine that parallelises and optimises automatically. It is a common replacement for pandas in Python.

name: Typst
tagline: A new markup-based typesetting system that is powerful and easy to learn.
description: Typst is a typesetting system designed as a modern alternative to LaTeX. The compiler is written in Rust and also runs in the browser via WebAssembly, powering the collaborative web app.

name: Helix
tagline: A post-modern modal text editor.
description: Helix is a terminal text editor written in Rust with Kakoune-style multiple selections, built-in language server support and tree-sitter syntax highlighting.

name: Alacritty
tagline: A cross-platform, OpenGL terminal emulator.
description: Alacritty is a fast terminal emulator written in Rust that uses the GPU for rendering. It focuses on simplicity and performance over built-in features like tabs and splits.

name: Rspack
tagline: A fast Rust-based web bundler with webpack-compatible API.
description: Rspack is a JavaScript bundler written in Rust and designed as a drop-in replacement for webpack, with an order of magnitude faster builds. It is developed by ByteDance and used in Rsbuild and Rslib.

name: Pingora
tagline: A library for building fast, reliable and evolvable network services, from Cloudflare.
description: Pingora is the Rust framework Cloudflare built to replace NGINX at its edge. It proxies tens of millions of requests per second and is open source for building proxies, gateways and load balancers.

name: Lapce
tagline: Lightning-fast and powerful code editor.
description: Lapce is a native code editor written in Rust with GPU-accelerated rendering via the Floem UI toolkit, built-in LSP support, remote development and a WASI plugin system.

name: Biome
tagline: A toolchain for the web: format, lint and more in a fraction of a second.
description: Biome is a formatter and linter for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, JSON, CSS and GraphQL, written in Rust. It is a community continuation of Rome Tools and runs as a single fast binary.

name: Fish Shell
tagline: The user-friendly command line shell for macOS, Linux, and the rest of the family.
description: fish is an interactive shell with autosuggestions, syntax highlighting and tab completion that works out of the box. As of version 4.0 the entire codebase was ported from C++ to Rust.

name: 1Password
tagline: The password manager trusted by millions of people and businesses.
description: 1Password's core library, shared across its desktop, mobile, browser and CLI apps, is written in Rust. The company has spoken publicly about Rust powering the cryptography and data layer behind every client.

name: Figma
tagline: The collaborative interface design tool.
description: Figma rewrote its multiplayer sync server in Rust in 2018 to cut tail latency and memory usage, and later used Rust for parts of its rendering pipeline compiled to WebAssembly.

name: Discord
tagline: Group chat that's all fun and games.
description: Discord rewrote its Read States service from Go to Rust to eliminate garbage-collection latency spikes, and uses Rust across game-SDK, data and infrastructure services.

name: Vercel Turbopack
tagline: The Rust-powered successor to Webpack, built into Next.js.
description: Turbopack is an incremental bundler written in Rust by Vercel, built on the Turbo engine's function-level caching. It is the default bundler for Next.js development.

name: Built with Rust
tagline: This directory. Axum, Maud and SQLite in a single binary.
description:
The site you are looking at. Rendered server-side with Maud, served by Axum, stored in SQLite, cached in memory as pre-compressed bytes, and deployed as one static binary.

The source is public; submissions and listings are managed through a small JSON API.
